tasks.question: What are the duration of the longest and shortest pop tracks in milliseconds?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT max(Milliseconds) ,  min(Milliseconds) FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.GenreId  =  T2.GenreId WHERE T1.Name  =  "Pop"

tasks.question: What is the department name of the students with lowest gpa belongs to?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T2.dept_name FROM student AS T1 JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.dept_code  =  T2.dept_code ORDER BY stu_gpa LIMIT 1

tasks.question: list in alphabetic order all course names and their instructors' names in year 2008.
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T1.title ,  T3.name FROM course AS T1 JOIN teaches AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id JOIN instructor AS T3 ON T2.id  =  T3.id WHERE YEAR  =  2008 ORDER BY T1.title

tasks.question: Give me the name and description of the location with code x.
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT location_name ,  location_description FROM Ref_locations WHERE location_code  =  "x"

tasks.question: Show the names and ids of tourist attractions that are visited at most once.
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T1.Name ,  T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN VISITS AS T2 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID  =  T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID GROUP BY T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID HAVING count(*)  <=  1

tasks.question: List the names of all the distinct customers who bought a keyboard.
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.customer_name FROM customers AS T1 JOIN customer_orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id JOIN order_items AS T3 ON T2.order_id  =  T3.order_id JOIN products AS T4 ON T3.product_id  =  T4.product_id WHERE T4.product_name  =  "keyboard"

tasks.question: What is the status code, mobile phone number and email address of customer with last name as Kohler or first name as Marina?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT customer_status_code ,  cell_mobile_phone_number ,  email_address FROM Customers WHERE first_name = "Marina" OR last_name  =  "Kohler"

tasks.question: How many routes go from the United States to Canada?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM routes WHERE dst_apid IN (SELECT apid FROM airports WHERE country  =  'Canada') AND src_apid IN (SELECT apid FROM airports WHERE country  =  'United States')

tasks.question: What is the id and last name of the driver who participated in the most races after 2010?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T1.driverid ,  T1.surname FROM drivers AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverid  =  T2.driverid JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceid = T3.raceid WHERE T3.year > 2010 GROUP BY T1.driverid ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.question: List the number of invoices from Chicago, IL.
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE billing_city  =  "Chicago" AND billing_state  =  "IL";

tasks.question: What is detail of the student who most recently registered course?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T2.student_details FROM student_course_registrations AS T1 JOIN students AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id ORDER BY T1.registration_date DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.question: What is the response received date for the document described as Regular that was granted more than 100 dollars?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T1.response_received_date FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Document_Types AS T2 ON T1.document_type_code  =  T2.document_type_code JOIN Grants AS T3 ON T1.grant_id  =  T3.grant_id WHERE T2.document_description  =  'Regular' OR T3.grant_amount  >  100

tasks.question: What are the last names of customers without invoice totals exceeding 20?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT LastName FROM CUSTOMER EXCEPT SELECT T1.LastName FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId  =  T2.CustomerId WHERE T2.total  >  20

tasks.question: How many professors are teaching class with code ACCT-211?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT PROF_NUM) FROM CLASS WHERE CRS_CODE  =  "ACCT-211"

tasks.question: What is the title, credit value, and department name for courses with more than one prerequisite?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T1.title ,  T1.credits , T1.dept_name FROM course AS T1 JOIN prereq AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id GROUP BY T2.course_id HAVING count(*)  >  1

tasks.question: Show different tourist attractions' names, ids, and the corresponding number of visits.
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T1.Name ,  T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID ,   COUNT(*) FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN VISITS AS T2 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID  =  T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID GROUP BY T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID

tasks.question: Return the distinct name of customers whose order status is Pending, in the order of customer id.
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.customer_name FROM customers AS T1 JOIN customer_orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id WHERE T2.order_status_code  =  "Pending" ORDER BY T2.customer_id

tasks.question: Which city does staff with first name as Janessa and last name as Sawayn live?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T1.city FROM Addresses AS T1 JOIN Staff AS T2 ON T1.address_id = T2.staff_address_id WHERE T2.first_name = "Janessa" AND T2.last_name = "Sawayn";

tasks.question: Find the distinct driver id of all drivers that have a longer stop duration than some drivers in the race whose id is 841?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT driverid ,  STOP FROM pitstops WHERE duration  >  (SELECT min(duration) FROM pitstops WHERE raceid  =  841)

tasks.question: What is the id of the candidate whose email is stanley.monahan@example.org?
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT T2.candidate_id FROM people AS T1 JOIN candidates AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.candidate_id WHERE T1.email_address = "stanley.monahan@example.org"
